CustomField.description: Set TRUE by F-UploadDocument flow when Document_Type__c = Signed SOF is uploaded to Quote Files. Triggers F-15 (SOF Upload Handler - Order Creator). Always use the Upload Document Quick Action, not direct field edit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked automatically when a Signed SOF document is attached via the Upload Document quick action. Triggers Order creation. Do not check manually - always use the quick action.
CustomField.label: Signed SOF Uploaded
